# Privacy — Immersion

Short version: **Immersion doesn't spy on you.**

## What gets sent to KVRNL

Only what's needed to check your license key:

| Data | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Your license key | To confirm it's valid |
| The product name | To know which app is asking |
| A hardware ID (HWID) | To enforce one-machine-per-key |

Your KVRNL account separately stores the **email address** you signed up with.

## What never gets sent

- Your files, documents, or media
- Keystrokes, screenshots, or screen contents
- Browsing history or activity in other apps
- Analytics, telemetry, usage tracking, or advertising identifiers

## Things you opt into

Some features only send data because you explicitly asked them to — submitting a
bug report, or using an in-app feature you configured with your own third-party
API key. Those are always your choice and always visible in the app.

## Auto-updates

Immersion checks GitHub for new releases. That's a normal web request to
GitHub's servers and includes no personal data from you.

## Your data, your call

Delete your KVRNL account at any time from your
[account page](https://kvrnl.io/account/) and your keys and email go with it.

Full policy: **https://kvrnl.io/privacy/**
